about: The passages of long texts chosen for a question (PassageFinder). Each case gives the texts, the question, the allowance in characters and the passage length; expected is one excerpt for each text, or null when there is nothing to choose by and the caller falls back to the beginning of the texts.

cases.name: texts that fit the allowance whole are not searched
texts:
Tomatoes need full sun all day.
Water the beds every morning.
Compost goes on in early spring.
cases.question: water

cases.name: a question of only common words gives nothing to search by
texts:
Tomatoes need full sun all day.
Water the beds every morning.
Compost goes on in early spring.
cases.question: What is it?

cases.name: a question none of whose words is in the texts
texts:
Tomatoes need full sun all day.
Water the beds every morning.
Compost goes on in early spring.
cases.question: greenhouse heating

cases.name: the matching passage, with a gap either side
texts:
Tomatoes need full sun all day.
Water the beds every morning.
Compost goes on in early spring.
cases.question: When do I water?

cases.name: a plural finds its singular, and neighbours run on
texts:
Tomatoes need full sun all day.
Water the beds every morning.
Compost goes on in early spring.
cases.question: bed compost
expected:
[…]
Water the beds every morning.
Compost goes on in early spring.

cases.name: equal scores are settled by place, and a passage that does not fit is passed over
texts:
Tomatoes need full sun all day.
Water the beds every morning.
Compost goes on in early spring.
cases.question: bed compost

cases.name: a text nothing was chosen from has an empty excerpt
texts:
Tomatoes need full sun all day.
Water the beds every morning.
Slugs eat the young lettuce at night.
cases.question: slugs
expected: Slugs eat the young lettuce at night.

cases.name: a line longer than a passage is cut through, and case does not matter
texts: aaaa bbbb cccc dddd EEEE ffff gggg hhhh iiii jjjj
cases.question: Eeee

cases.name: the rarer word counts for more
texts:
Water the lettuce.
Water the tomatoes.
Water the beans and feed them.
cases.question: water feed
expected:
[…]
Water the beans and feed them.
